comparison_and_counterexample: The comparison is the two-site joint swap against the native layout at the same coordinates, not a new region. Slot 12 is where N rather than C is supported: it is the higher-scoring legal layout's N destination and has the largest positive N-minus-C in the patch. Slot 22 is where C is preferred: it is the native N that the alternative layout replaces with C, and its N-minus-C is only +0.0763 with a weak donor match (A:VAL:116:N, 0.951). Counterexamples and limits: the native-minus-alternate mean is small (0.0763) and the native score (8.704859) is close to the best legal score (8.912224), so the alternative is not a decisive winner; the best legal counterfactual target has not been regenerated or relaxed and is not an observed successful path. Prior rounds show the risk of over-reading type terms: R04/R07 (patch L093, endpoint 0.4/half 0.3/type 0.3) drove local_NC_identity_accuracy to 0.375 with aromatic_N_role_fraction 0.0 and best_qualified_pic50 8.1289, and R08 (L070, disconnected N anchors) gave 0.3194 identity accuracy with 22/24 qualified; R03 (L036, type 0.4) reached only 8.1281. R11/R12 (L109, R13 context calibration) reproduced the incumbent almost exactly (best_qualified_pic50 8.3779 and 8.1262), showing that context-only changes do not move the terminal score. These are measured alternative layouts that contradict any claim that adding N at a favorable destination while leaving the former N untouched is equivalent to the scored fixed-count layout; the declared intervention is the joint swap, and the compensating C site (slot 22) must be inspected. Proximity alone, total N count, or N--N spacing cannot establish a transferable high-affinity rule, and the aromatic N donor-facing match is only a chemical-role geometry proxy.

falsifier: Prospective falsifier: if the joint swap at slots 12 and 22, run under the frozen R13 geometry and dose with only the N/C targets exchanged, fails to raise qualified final pIC50 above the incumbent 8.3780 (and toward the 8.704806 target) while local_NC_identity_accuracy at the two typed sites does not exceed the R12 context-only value of 0.8333, then the claim that this measured two-site N/C relocation is a supported local intervention is falsified. A further falsifier is a confirmation run in which the destination slot 12 does not retain the desired N label or the compensating slot 22 does not retain the desired C label, or in which the measured alternative layout's advantage over the native layout does not reproduce; in that case defer rather than inventing evidence, since the best legal counterfactual target has not been regenerated or relaxed and is not an observed successful path.
